features: Inkjet Printer Compatible – No Lamination Needed: Special ink-receptive coating allows direct printing using standard inkjet printers (with dye or pigment ink), eliminating the need for lamination, ribbons, or specialized equipment.
Premium 800 Micron Thickness: Crafted with durable 800-micron (0.8mm) PVC material — sturdy yet flexible, offering a premium, credit-card-like feel with enhanced longevity.
Sharp, Smudge-Free Output: Produces rich, high-resolution prints with excellent color accuracy and edge-to-edge clarity — ideal for photo IDs, logos, and QR/barcodes.
Standard CR80 Card Size: 86mm x 54mm dimensions (CR80) make these cards universally compatible with badge holders, access control systems, and slot punches.
Water & Scratch Resistant: Surface coating offers high resistance to water, scratches, and general wear — ensuring long-lasting professional appearance even in frequent-use environments.
Multi-Industry Applications: Perfect for employee IDs, school or college identity cards, event passes, visitor badges, library cards, membership & loyalty programs, and more.
Smooth Edge & Flat Finish: Designed for smooth feeding through printers and handling — no warping, sticking, or uneven surfaces.
Bulk Friendly & Cost Effective: Available in various pack sizes to suit institutional or small business needs — reliable, affordable solution for frequent printing.
